findings.message: static/img/figures/gpks-402/unit-04/fig-U4-6.ur.svg (and its .ur.dark twin) is a translation of the freehand 'map-style' outline that PR #368 withdrew on 2026-10-29 for an invented border, Thar drawn outside the country and Jammu and Kashmir missing. All 31 of its paths equal the withdrawn file (git show c1301f27^:static/img/figures/gpks-402/unit-04/fig-U4-6.svg); it shares none of the current EN map's Natural Earth geometry and has no Jammu and Kashmir, Line of Control, Working Boundary or disputed-territory note. specs/content/gpks-402/figures/unit-04.md says maps of real territory are never drawn freehand. Root cause: the G4 baseline 64ced416 (2026-10-28) predates #368 and #369. Repair: rebuild fig-U4-6.ur.svg from the current static/img/figures/gpks-402/unit-04/fig-U4-6.svg geometry with translated labels, keeping the boundary and disputed-territory notes. The map itself still awaits owner sign-off (#369).

'check' (one branch checks another) and 'checks and balances' are rendered as نگرانی / باہمی نگرانی ('supervision, oversight') at index L40 and L51, topic-01 L10, L26, L124-L129, L206, L211, L218, topic-02 L151, unit-assessment L23 and L27, and in the fig-U4-1.ur.svg arrow label 'نگرانی اور تقرریاں'. The reading suffers most at topic-01 L129, 'پارلیمنٹ اور انتظامیہ عدالتوں کی نگرانی کرتی ہیں' ('Parliament and the executive supervise the courts'), which contradicts the judicial independence taught at L122. The term is not in the frozen bank. Owner ruling proposed: 'اختیارات میں توازن اور روک ٹوک (چیک اینڈ بیلنس)', with the verb 'پر روک لگاتا ہے / کو قابو میں رکھتا ہے' in place of 'کی نگرانی کرتا ہے'. The bank is not changed.

The translator's handoff (specs/content/gpks-402/reviews/unit-04/G4/translation-handoff.md) proposes 16 unbanked display terms: Federalism وفاقیت, Separation of Powers اختیارات کی علیحدگی, Fundamental Rights بنیادی حقوق, Strategic Importance تزویراتی اہمیت, Legislature مقننہ, Executive انتظامیہ, Judiciary عدلیہ, Civil-military relations سول ملٹری تعلقات, Martial law مارشل لا, Writ petition رٹ پٹیشن, Principles of Policy حکمتِ عملی کے اصول, Citizen شہری, Indus River System دریائے سندھ کا نظام, Climate آب و ہوا, Natural resources قدرتی وسائل, CPEC چین پاکستان اقتصادی راہداری. I find them accurate and consistently used, but 'Principles of Policy' is conventionally 'پالیسی کے اصول' in Urdu civics texts, and تزویراتی is less familiar to entering students than 'اسٹریٹجک'. Owner ruling requested. The pending Unit 1 ruling on the frozen oblique form 'پاکستان کے مطالعہ' (index key_terms L20-21) applies here too.

No rendered normal, 360px or A4 print inspection of the five Urdu pages or the 14 Urdu SVG variants was possible. The crew brief forbids build, servers and Chromium, measure-figure-text.mjs needs Chromium, rsvg-convert is not installed, and ImageMagick MSVG cannot shape Nastaliq. Nastaliq legibility, bidi punctuation with Latin citations and article numbers such as 184(3) and 58(2)(b), table column order, the mirrored fig-U4-3 timeline, label clipping and the .ur.svg text geometry all remain unverified. A host with browser access is needed.

Gate gap, routed to the crew lead and not the translator: check:content, check:figures and check:map-sources all pass with F1 and F2 present. The figure parity check does not run while translation_status is draft, and the map-provenance gate scans manifest rows only, so a stale .ur.svg map that no manifest row describes is invisible to it. A G4 job translating from a baseline older than the current EN figures is not detected.

Small meaning drifts: topic-01 L148 'asserted civilian control' becomes 'سول اختیار قائم رکھا' ('maintained'), suggest 'سول بالادستی منوائی'; L149 'a controlled civilian system' becomes 'محدود سول نظام' ('limited'), suggest 'فوج کے زیرِ اثر سول نظام'; L42 'the amendment's main step' becomes 'سب سے بڑا قدم' ('biggest step'), suggest 'بنیادی قدم'; topic-02 L114 'validity' becomes 'آئینی حیثیت', where 'جواز' is closer.

Wording: topic-02 L34 'بنیادی حقوق وہ بنیادی حقوق ہیں' is circular, suggest 'بنیادی حقوق وہ اساسی حقوق ہیں'; topic-02 L147 'یہ عادتیں اس کا حصہ ہیں جو آئین کا مطلب ہے جب وہ ...' is a calque, suggest 'جب آئین ریاست سے تعصب کی حوصلہ شکنی کا کہتا ہے تو اس کا مطلب یہی عادتیں بھی ہیں'; fig-U4-7.ur.svg 'پنجاب اور سندھ کا سندھ میدان', suggest 'پنجاب اور سندھ میں سندھ کا میدان'; topic-01 L22 'ہائی اسکول برائے طلبہ' loses 'boys', suggest 'لڑکوں کا سرکاری ہائی اسکول'.
